_comment: Generic conventions used by the mapping suggester. Configuration, not business rules:
business rules (constants, value mappings, selections) are entered and approved by the functional team.
isoCodeTags        : code tags whose values follow an international standard and pass through unchanged (DIRECT).
All other code tags are suggested as VALUE_MAP from source to canonical.
continuationTags   : a tag whose overflow continues in another tag (long name -> additional name line).
pickFlagSuffixes   : flag tags used to pick one entry of a collection (standard address, default phone).
minStructureOverlap: share of a target structure's meanings a source structure must provide to be suggested.
flagFalseValues    : values treated as false when a code is converted to a flag (functional team can change the rule).
